title: Remove small stalls in the attractor and the fractal snapshot
acceptance: The attractor sets its canvas size once at mount; resize() does nothing when the size is unchanged.
No fractal snapshot task over 50 ms.
e2e/live-mcp.spec.js stays green and the Composer owner reviews: the attractor is the embed's only moving visual.
Merges after the remaining LIVE-002 host session.
